hardware.bluetooth.enable.description: Whether to enable support for Bluetooth.

hardware.graphics.enable32Bit.description:
On 64-bit systems, whether to also install 32-bit drivers for
32-bit applications (such as Wine).

hardware.sane.enable.description:
Enable support for SANE scanners.

::: {.note}
Users in the "scanner" group will gain access to the scanner, or the "lp" group if it's also a printer.
:::

hardware.steam-hardware.enable.description: Enable udev rules for Steam hardware such as the Steam Controller, other supported controllers and the HTC Vive

hardware.xone.enable.description: Whether to enable the xone driver for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S accessories.

i18n.defaultLocale.description:
The default locale. It determines the language for program messages,
the format for dates and times, sort order, and so on. Setting the
default character set is done via {option}`i18n.defaultCharset`.

networking.firewall.enable.description:
Whether to enable the firewall.  This is a simple stateful
firewall that blocks connection attempts to unauthorised TCP
or UDP ports on this machine.

networking.networkmanager.enable.description:
Whether to use NetworkManager to obtain an IP address and other
configuration for all network interfaces that are not manually
configured. If enabled, a group `networkmanager`
will be created. Add all users that should have permission
to change network settings to this group.

programs.gamemode.enable.description: Whether to enable GameMode to optimise system performance on demand.

services.avahi.enable.description:
Whether to run the Avahi daemon, which allows Avahi clients
to use Avahi's service discovery facilities and also allows
the local machine to advertise its presence and services
(through the mDNS responder implemented by `avahi-daemon`).

services.avahi.publish.enable.description: Whether to allow publishing in general.

services.fstrim.enable.description: Whether to enable periodic SSD TRIM of mounted partitions in background.

services.fwupd.enable.description:
Whether to enable fwupd, a DBus service that allows
applications to update firmware.

services.ipp-usb.enable.description: Whether to enable ipp-usb, a daemon to turn an USB printer/scanner supporting IPP everywhere (aka AirPrint, WSD, AirScan) into a locally accessible network printer/scanner.

services.jellyfin.enable.description: Whether to enable Jellyfin Media Server.

services.openssh.enable.description:
Whether to enable the OpenSSH secure shell daemon, which
allows secure remote logins.

services.pipewire.jack.enable.description: Whether to enable JACK audio emulation.

services.pipewire.pulse.enable.description: Whether to enable PulseAudio server emulation.

services.power-profiles-daemon.enable.description:
Whether to enable power-profiles-daemon, a DBus daemon that allows
changing system behavior based upon user-selected power profiles.

services.printing.enable.description: Whether to enable printing support through the CUPS daemon.

services.tailscale.enable.description: Whether to enable Tailscale client daemon.

services.thermald.enable.description: Whether to enable thermald, the temperature management daemon.

services.xserver.xkb.layout.description: X keyboard layout, or multiple keyboard layouts separated by commas.

socle.base.bootvine.description: Whether to enable bootvine: the start and the shutdown show systemd's jobs as a tree.

socle.base.determinate.description: Whether to enable Determinate Nix in place of Nix from Nixpkgs.

socle.base.keepVersions.description: The versions of the system that stay to go back to; older ones are removed each week.

socle.base.nh.description: Whether to enable nh, set to socle's folder, for the terminal.

socle.base.outputMonitor.description: Whether to enable nix-output-monitor: builds shown as a tree in the terminal.

socle.desktop.autoLogin.enable.description: Opens one person's session at start, with no password.

socle.desktop.dark.description: Windows, menus and panels in dark colours.

socle.desktop.environment.description: The desktop that people see after they log in.

socle.desktop.lockAfter.description: Locks the session once the screen goes off, after this many minutes; 0: never.

socle.packages.description: The apps, by their attribute in Nixpkgs.

socle.people.description: The people of the machine, by their login.

socle.unfree.description: The packages whose licence is not free that the person accepted, one by one.

time.timeZone.description:
The time zone used when displaying times and dates. See <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones>
for a comprehensive list of possible values for this setting.

If null, the timezone will default to UTC and can be set imperatively
using timedatectl.
